nodes.label: bin/test-gate Deploy Gate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Wired into bin/compose so any --env/--prod deploy runs the full test suite (frontend lint/typecheck/test/build, ephemeral Rails+Postgres+Redis stack, Playwright e2e) first; a failure aborts before any build or container restart. Proven by deliberately breaking a spec and confirming the deploy aborted before dc build/prepare_db/dc up ran, with zero leftover containers. Later found bin/compose's 'up' case never ran dc build, silently redeploying stale images for three increments — fixed by making dc build unconditional.

nodes.label: Admin-Visibility Ruby-Filter Workaround (accessible_by block-condition gap)
nodes.rationale: CanCanCan's accessible_by only applies the SQL-expressible half of a rule and silently ignores a Ruby block condition (AppConfig[:show_admins]), which would leak admin members to users who shouldn't see them. Fixed by loading the scoped relation, rejecting per-object via ability.cannot?(:show, u), then paginating the filtered array in Ruby rather than the SQL scope.

nodes.label: AppConfig Key-Value Store
nodes.rationale: AppConfig is a dumb key/value store, not a fixed-schema ActiveRecord model, so there is no natural per-field REST resource. The API instead exposes a whitelisted registry of known keys (KNOWN_KEYS) mirroring the legacy view's hand-written list, via one list-all and one bulk-update endpoint, deliberately never accepting an arbitrary key from the request body.

nodes.label: bin/deploy-to Containerized Deploy Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Replaces manual build-locally+tar-over-ssh with a single command that builds, hash-verifies (GIT_HASH build-arg baked into each image, queryable via /version.json and /api/v1/health), and swaps both frontend and API containers symmetrically, booting each on a temporary smoke port and polling its hash endpoint before swapping — with an automatic rollback trap restoring the previous image tag on failure. Modeled on the sibling dominik-elsbroek.de project's deploy-to.

nodes.label: Continuous-Delivery Cadence (no per-area pause)
nodes.rationale: The user originally asked for a stop-and-get-feedback checkpoint after every area; superseded by an explicit request to drop the per-area pause and drive remaining areas continuously ('do the big bang'). Each area still goes through brainstorm -> plan -> subagent-driven-development -> task review -> final whole-branch review -> gate-verified deploy, just without a deliberate human-feedback pause between areas.
